verdict.rationale: Vapi documents OpenAI-style function calling and custom webhook-based Function Tools: the assistant pings your server URL with a `tool-calls` message mid-call to do things like look up a customer record. Nothing in the pack shows how tool results are spoken back, or any filler or wait message that covers tool latency. Idle messages address user inactivity, not tool-call dead air, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented mechanism for speaking tool results, request-start/filler messages to avoid dead air during tool execution, independent hands-on corroboration of tool-call latency handling.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Vapi supports OpenAI-style tool/function calling. Assistants can ping your server to perform actions.
When tools are triggered, your Server URL receives a `tool-calls` message
This guide shows you how to create custom tools, including Function Tools, for your Vapi assistants.
transfer the call, look up a customer record, book an appointment, or end the call
